title: A pressure-antinode activation field can oppose a node trap
statement: From read standing-wave potential20, Phi=f1/3+Re(f2)/2 gives F=4*pi*a^3*Phi*k*E*sin(2kx), E=p_a^2/(4rho c^2). Positive Phi makes an antinode unstable. Separate-frequency trap and activation, assuming cross terms average away, give -A_T sin(2k_Tx)+s A_C sin(2k_Cx)+F_b and local K=8pi a^3(Phi_T k_T^2E_T-s Phi_C k_C^2E_C). This is an introduced isolated-sphere one-dimensional force contract, not 3D confinement, acoustic streaming or a lock.
